children: Wholesale price inflation in Pakistan rose to 11.82% year-on-year in August 2026 from 9.43% in the previous month, marking the strongest growth in three months.

Costs increased for agriculture, forestry, and fishery (9.49% vs 7.61% in July), other transportable goods (26.80% vs 20.44%), and food, beverages, tobacco, textiles, and leather products (8.10% vs 7.40%), driven largely by stronger inflation for food, beverages, and tobacco (10.51% vs 9.40%), while price growth for textiles and leather products remained steady at 19.21%.
Moreover, prices rebounded for ores, minerals, electricity, gas, and water (1.87% vs -0.39%).
Meanwhile, price growth slowed for metal products, machinery, and equipment (5.16% vs 6.19%).
On a monthly basis, wholesale prices rose by 2.0% in August, following a flat reading in the preceding month.

title: Pakistan Wholesale Inflation at 3-Month High
